name: COMP_017
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (79%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Invasive · Careful review

Invasive leads, but Normal stays in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 79%, Normal 16% | Clear lead, Normal second |
| Conformal set | Normal, Invasive | Two classes not separated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.92 / 76th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Invasive | Two InSitu neighbors dissent [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score in high-risk regions · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Score peaks in this region only · Validated
- **Benign stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · High score, failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown faithful. Mitoses and normal lobules (both 0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The true class is Normal: regions 0, 1, 4, 5, 9 lower the invasive score.
- High-risk regions rest on features other than the mitosis score, which failed its spot check.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 11**: confirm nuclear pleomorphism and invasive growth.
2. **Region 6**: confirm tumor-infiltrating stroma.
3. **Regions 0, 8, 9**: confirm benign architecture, since Normal is in the set.
